meta.name: copywriting-analyzer
meta.description: Scores, audits, and rewrites B2B cold emails and outreach sequences against research-backed performance criteria targeting 8.5%+ reply rates. Use this skill whenever the user shares a cold email, a sequence, or any sales outreach copy and wants feedback, a score, or an improved version — even if they just say "review this email", "improve my sequence", "is this cold email good?", "score my outreach", or paste an email without further context. Always produces a full scorecard + a rewritten version of the email.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评分并重写B2B冷邮件,提升回复率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要提升B2B冷邮件的回复率
copy.tagline_en: Score and rewrite B2B cold emails to boost reply rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve B2B cold email reply rates

howto.what: 当用户提供B2B冷邮件或外联文本时，Claude会按11个维度评分，识别性能杀手，并输出完整的评分卡和重写版本。
howto.when: 用户分享冷邮件、外联序列或销售文案，并希望获得反馈、评分或改进版本时触发（例如说“review this email”或直接粘贴邮件）。

say.text: 帮我评审这封冷邮件，给出评分和改写建议。
say.note: 技能将分析邮件并输出评分卡和重写版本。

say.text: 给这个外联序列打分，告诉我哪里需要改进。
say.note: 技能会评估整个序列的各个维度。

say.text: 请改写这封开发信，使其更可能获得回复。
say.note: 技能会基于评分结果优化邮件内容。

howto.what_en: When a user provides a B2B cold email or outreach text, Claude scores it across 11 dimensions, detects performance killers, and outputs a full scorecard plus a rewritten version.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user shares a cold email, outreach sequence, or sales copy and wants feedback, a score, or an improved version. It activates even if they just say "review this email" or paste an email without context.

say_en.text: Review this cold email and give me a score and rewrite suggestions.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze the email and output a scorecard and rewritten version.

say_en.text: Score this outreach sequence and tell me what needs improvement.
say_en.note: The skill will evaluate each dimension of the sequence.

say_en.text: Rewrite this cold email to be more reply-worthy.
say_en.note: The skill will optimize based on scoring results.
